title: alyssum macrocarpum var. candolleanum
intro: Alyssum macrocarpum var. candolleanum, commonly known as Candolle's alyssum or sweet alyssum, is a flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, such as reducing anxiety and stress, improving sleep quality, and possessing anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Candolle's alyssum include its sedative and anxiolytic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including essential oils and flavonoids. The bioactive constituents of Candolle's alyssum include linalool, geraniol, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits.
